datasets.name: dq_volume_history
queryLines:
-- v2 params
SELECT
  dataset_name,
  observed_row_count,
  failed_count AS difference_from_baseline,
  status,
  executed_at
FROM
  genie_dq_volume_history
WHERE
  executed_at
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(executed_at)
      FROM
        genie_dq_volume_history
    )
  AND layer = 'BRONZE'
  AND (
    (:vol_dataset_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:vol_dataset_name) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:vol_dataset_name, dataset_name)
  )
  AND (
    (:vol_status IS NULL OR cardinality(:vol_status) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:vol_status, status)
  )
ORDER BY
  dataset_name

datasets.name: dq_dataset_scores
queryLines:
-- v2 params
SELECT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct IS NULL THEN 'Not Measured'
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct >= 99 THEN 'Pass'
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct >= 95 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Fail'
  END AS score_category
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      layer,
      dataset_name,
      COUNT(*) AS total_checks,
      COUNT_IF(status = 'PASS') AS passed_checks,
      COUNT_IF(status = 'WARNING') AS warning_checks,
      COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL') AS failed_checks,
      SUM(failed_count) AS failed_rule_evaluations,
      ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(passed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0),
        3
      ) AS weighted_quality_score_pct
    FROM
      `ftw-week-07`.`05-data-quality`.`genie_latest_check_results`
    WHERE
      (
        (:layer IS NULL OR cardinality(:layer) = 0)
        OR array_contains(:layer, layer)
      )
      AND (
        (:dataset_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:dataset_name) = 0)
        OR array_contains(:dataset_name, dataset_name)
      )
      AND (
        (:quality_dimension IS NULL OR cardinality(:quality_dimension) = 0)
        OR array_contains(:quality_dimension, quality_dimension)
      )
      AND (
        (:status IS NULL OR cardinality(:status) = 0)
        OR array_contains(:status, status)
      )
    GROUP BY
      layer,
      dataset_name
  ) t
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN failed_checks > 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  dataset_name

datasets.name: dq_problem_areas
queryLines:
-- v2 params
SELECT
  executed_at,
  layer,
  dataset_name,
  column_name,
  check_name,
  quality_dimension,
  check_type,
  expectation,
  threshold_pct,
  severity,
  check_owner,
  total_count,
  failed_count,
  failure_pct,
  status
FROM
  `ftw-week-07`.`05-data-quality`.`genie_latest_check_results`
WHERE
  status IN ('FAIL', 'WARNING')
  AND (
    (:layer IS NULL OR cardinality(:layer) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:layer, layer)
  )
  AND (
    (:dataset_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:dataset_name) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:dataset_name, dataset_name)
  )
  AND (
    (:quality_dimension IS NULL OR cardinality(:quality_dimension) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:quality_dimension, quality_dimension)
  )
  AND (
    (:status IS NULL OR cardinality(:status) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:status, status)
  )
  AND (
    (:severity IS NULL OR cardinality(:severity) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:severity, severity)
  )
  AND (
    (:check_owner IS NULL OR cardinality(:check_owner) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:check_owner, check_owner)
  )
  AND (
    (:column_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:column_name) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:column_name, column_name)
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN severity = 'CRITICAL' THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  failed_count DESC

datasets.name: dq_canonical_dimensions
queryLines:
SELECT
  dimension_order,
  dimension_key,
  dimension_label,
  total_checks,
  passed_checks,
  warning_checks,
  failed_checks,
  failed_rule_evaluations,
  weighted_quality_score_pct,
  measurement_status,
  CASE
    WHEN
      dimension_key = 'ACCURACY'
      AND weighted_quality_score_pct IS NULL
    THEN
      'N/A — Accuracy validation has not run.'
    ELSE measurement_note
  END AS measurement_note,
  CASE
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct IS NULL THEN 'Not Measured'
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct >= 99 THEN 'Pass'
    WHEN weighted_quality_score_pct >= 95 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Fail'
  END AS score_category
FROM
  genie_dq_canonical_dimensions
ORDER BY
  dimension_order

datasets.name: dq_owner_summary
queryLines:

SELECT
  check_owner,
  COUNT(*) AS checks_needing_attention,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL') AS failed_checks,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'WARNING') AS warning_checks,
  SUM(failed_count) AS failed_rule_evaluations
FROM
  `ftw-week-07`.`05-data-quality`.`genie_latest_check_results`
WHERE
  status IN ('FAIL', 'WARNING')
  AND (
    (:severity IS NULL OR cardinality(:severity) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:severity, severity)
  )
  AND (
    (:check_owner IS NULL OR cardinality(:check_owner) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:check_owner, check_owner)
  )
  AND (
    (:column_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:column_name) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:column_name, column_name)
  )
GROUP BY
  check_owner
ORDER BY
  failed_checks DESC,
  warning_checks DESC

datasets.name: dq_source_rows_filtered
queryLines:
WITH ranked_volume AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY dataset_name
        ORDER BY executed_at DESC, run_id DESC
      ) AS volume_rank
  FROM
    `ftw-week-07`.`05-data-quality`.`genie_dq_volume_history`
  WHERE
    layer = 'BRONZE'
)
SELECT
  dataset_name,
  observed_row_count,
  failed_count AS difference_from_baseline,
  status,
  executed_at
FROM
  ranked_volume
WHERE
  volume_rank = 1
  AND (
    (:dataset_name IS NULL OR cardinality(:dataset_name) = 0)
    OR array_contains(:dataset_name, dataset_name)
